description: List expenses (id, client_id, project_id, user_id, amount, currency, date, notes, invoiced, tags). Paymo: GET /api/expenses.

date_from.description: Only expenses dated on/after this day.

date_to.description: Only expenses dated on/before this day.

invoiced.description: true = already invoiced, false = not yet invoiced.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 100, max 500). Paymo has no pagination; results beyond this are truncated.

where.description: Extra raw Paymo filter ANDed onto the typed ones, e.g. `billable=true` or `name like Website`. Operators: = > >= < <= != like, not like, in (a,b), not in (a,b).

name: paymo_list_expenses
title: List expenses
